sequence.block: // Configure Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x028, 0x00000000); // Set Circular Buffer mode Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x034, 0x00000000); // Watermark: Set threshold vacancy to 0 to use full buffer Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304, 0x00000003); // FFCR: Enable Formatter and Trigger Insertion Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x01C, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___TRIGGER_COUNT); // TRG: Number of words to capture after trigger Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x308, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___SYNCCNT); // Set PSCR Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x018, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS); // Init RwP Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x014, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS); // Init RRP Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x11C, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS_HI); // Init DBAHI Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x118, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS); // Init DBALO Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x004, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_SIZE); // Init RSZ Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x110, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___AXI_CTL); // Init AXICTL Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0xED0, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___AXI_CTL1); // Init AXICTL1 Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x03C, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS_HI); // Init RWPHI Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x038, ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___BUFFER_ADDRESS_HI); // Init RRPHI Write32(ETR___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x020, 0x00000001); // Enable ETR
